item.title: Phrases Reading Worksheets: Make Your Own, Free
item.description: Phrases reading worksheets you can make in a minute: type your own words or numbers and print. Pick color or black and white, then print as many pages as you need. It is made for kids ages 4 to 8, from preschool to 2nd grade. It is free: print it or try it at sounditoutreading.com.
